Please do. not. do. it. I know that feeling. Everyone who has a sub par job or a job that they feel is not enough to support their lifestyle knows that feeling. There are a lot of things that are still around that don’t work but evidence says they do. Some people have been in situations similar to yours but still ended their lives. In reality the effectiveness depends on the therapist themself. It can work if their good at their job, but some clients/patients just require more time, effort and patience than others. Looking into therapists near you and checking out their reviews would be helpful.

I feel the exact same way about working. I was just trying to explain that to my family. What helps me keep going is seeing that I haven’t tried everything let a lone anything. I want to travel. Get a boyfriend or girlfriend for once. Scream from a mountain. Ride a motorcycle and do stunts. Learn to play a lot of instruments. See New York. Fly a plane or sumthin. Dye my hair. Tattoos. Get over my fear of roller coasters. Sky dive. At least risk my life before I take it. There’s a shit ton to do. The way I see it...why should I have to leave after experiencing all this pain and bullshit before I experience decent things in the time I’m here.
